meta.purpose: Expert-reviewed corrections layered on the calibrated prior (Phase 2.3a). apply_calibrated_priors uses these where present; the panel output is never silently edited.
meta.source: calibration-review-sweep workflow: 186 high-impact techniques, 2 black-belt reviewers + adjudicator per batch
meta.note: 176/186 trusted (incl. the big-drop fundamentals). These 10 are ruleset-mechanics fixes (heel-hook gi-illegality, gi-grip-dependent lasso/berimbolo dying in no-gi, and 2 direction/mirror fixes).

Counter Leg Attack.reason: Inside-sankaku counters are heel-hook-driven (legal/developed in no-gi, ~illegal in gi where limited to kneebar/toehold/ankle) — a canonical ruleset fork, so no-gi > gi.

Omoplata from Lasso.reason: Both refork; lasso is sleeve-grip dependent so the no-gi pathway is near-dead — panel's 25 too high, averaging the two corrections to 13.

Lasso Sweep.reason: Both refork; sweep needs the sleeve+leg lasso configuration, near-dead without cloth — panel's 20 too high, averaging corrections to 12.

Berimbolo Entry.reason: Both refork to the same values; berimbolo relies on collar/sleeve/belt grips off DLR, near-dead in no-gi — panel's 25 too high.

Posture Recovery.reason: Both reviewers agree the calibration reversed direction: bottom's gi collar/sleeve grips break and hold posture, so recovering/standing out is harder in gi, easier no-gi (nogi>gi).

Heel Hook from Ashi Garami.reason: Reviewers split; heel hook illegal IBJJF gi, snap gi to sibling heel-hook floor (12) for consistency, no-gi 37 kept.

Heel Hook from Saddle.reason: Both reviewers refork: heel hooks illegal in gi at purple-brown, so gi floors ~11 (37 far too high); no-gi saddle heel hook at 45 stands.

Heel Hook from Kneebar Control.reason: Both reviewers refork: heel hook illegal in gi, gi floors ~10 not 32; no-gi ~41 fine.

Inside Sankaku Heel Hook.reason: Both refork; heel hook illegal in gi at purple-brown (~10), top no-gi saddle finish (~60), original gi 49 implausible.

Rear Naked Choke from Gift Wrap.reason: Reviewers split; RNC is grip/legality-neutral so an 8pt fork violates the mirrored-within-3 rule — bump gi to near-mirror per A.
